scope: Offline review of the retained Infinity MIUI Camera bundle and the earlier CN launch trace. No phone access, APK patch, policy update or new camera installation.

runtime_evidence.rom: Earlier PLG110 CN installation, not current Global
runtime_evidence.camera_permission: foreground access permitted in the saved AppOps report
runtime_evidence.camera_service: Camera 0 opened through the retained Xiaomi HAL, then disconnected before a usable preview was established.
runtime_evidence.log_loss: Application log flow control reported 3869 rows dropped. The saved trace does not preserve a definitive initiating error for the disconnect.

global_image_inventory.limit: This inventory describes the canonical Global OS tree, not later data-app installs on the phone. The optional camera bundle is available separately; current Global MIUI Camera behavior is not established by the old CN trace.

findings.evidence: CameraAppImpl.onCreate passes a compiled false value to MIVISDKConfig.setSupportMIVI2InMTK. MIVICaptureManager selects its Qcom implementation when either the generic MIVI2 or MIVI3 JPEG flag is true.
findings.conclusion: The Qcom implementation name alone does not establish incorrect CPU detection. Do not force the MTK flag based only on this log line.

findings.evidence: Qd/c caches Build.DEVICE; Qd/a supplies a lazy profile-name value through Lk/t; An/q.k constructs the per-device profile class and falls back to common/manufacturer handling when lookup fails.
findings.conclusion: The trace uses an OPPO device name rather than dash. Verify the actual selected profile in a controlled trial before adding a package-scoped identity adaptation. The source path is a concrete compatibility suspect, not a proven explanation of the disconnect.

findings.evidence: Qd/b.F0 combines the profile default, camera.debug.mivi2 and persist.vendor.camera.mivi.version. It can enable MIVI2 when the vendor version is 2.
findings.conclusion: Inspect existing values and profile selection together; do not globally change vendor camera properties or disable MIVI without testing.

findings.evidence: The app continued past missing MTKBoostFramework/MtkBoostFramework and optional CameraOptManager messages and reached CameraService connect.
findings.conclusion: Those startup messages alone do not justify injecting vendor framework classes or broad permission rules.

first_checks: Confirm whether the exact signed bundle is installed on Global and record its code path/hash.
Capture the first failure with sufficient log retention and identify the actual selected camera profile class.
Compare the exact same APK and profile result with the known working Infinity installation if needed.
next_trial.candidate_hypothesis: A package-scoped dash profile selection may restore the intended camera feature set; it must be evaluated independently of logging and permission changes.
acceptance: A still image saves and reopens.
Camera closes and reopens without a service or app crash.
not_performed: No broad SELinux or filesystem-permission changes.
